headline: Apple approves Poke as the first AI agent on its Messages for Business platform
snapshot: Poke, the startup that lets people use AI agents through simple text messages, has become the first AI agent approved for Apple's Messages for Business platform. The competitive question is whether this changes the model race, enterprise integrations or customer lock-in as major AI providers battle for durable platform advantage.
